english.title: Transport worker - fail to provide specimen
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required to provide

(A)_[a specimen or specimens of breath for analysis by means of a device of a type approved by the Secretary of State]_
(B)_[a specimen of blood for a laboratory test]_
(C)_[a specimen of urine for a laboratory test]_

pursuant to section 31 of the Transport and Works Act 1992 in the course of an investigation into whether you had committed an offence under section 27 thereof, failed, without reasonable excuse, to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(8) and 36(1) of the Transport and Works Act 1992.

other.powersofarrest: The offender would normally be in detention at the time this request is made.
other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
